object_aliases.rule: Treat as synonyms for the same furniture object in context.
Do not assume equivalence when container type matters; drinking the same liquid is normally the same drinking event.
Contextual overlap; do not assume universal synonymy.
Contextual overlap; preserve distinctions in size, structure and use.
Opening/closing a cabinet door and opening/closing its cabinet entry usually describe the same access-state event.

distinctions: take into is directed carrying/placing; preserve direction

examples: put/place/set an object onto a surface
distinctions: set the table is a different sense
put into and take out preserve container direction
drink a cup/glass of liquid remains drinking; container substitution alone is weak
look through a picture/book is inspect/view, not photograph or physical take
preserve direction and destination where stated
same object and resulting closed state are equivalent

review_rules.unit: candidate_qid once, after deduplicating across all five releases
rules: Compare whole events and semantic roles, not changed words alone.
Equivalent or source-entailing candidates are exclude.
Candidate-entails-source, uncertain overlap, unclear syntax/roles/direction, and ambiguity are quarantine unless clearly an invalid construction, which is exclude.
Keep only clear, natural, distinct events after checking all same-video original positive queries for direct conflict.
Use the approved short-Charades construction assumption: a meaningfully distinct event is ordinarily absent; do not require per-video viewing.
Do not use existing group, partition, model predictions, verifier scores, or performance as semantic evidence.
Each result must include original source and candidate descriptions, relation, decision, and a specific reason per qid.
review_rules.same_video_gt_rule: If candidate event is expressed by any original positive query for the same vid, exclude. Otherwise do not infer presence from video viewing.
